local_skills.name: ilyra-graph-shape
local_skills.guidance: Summarize exact node and edge shape while retaining isolated obligations.

local_skills.guidance: Produce the deterministic index-stable topological order.

local_skills.name: ilyra-reachability-matrix
local_skills.guidance: Materialize reflexive reachability for the declared obligation DAG.

local_skills.name: ilyra-ancestor-sets
local_skills.guidance: List each obligation's strict upstream dependencies.

local_skills.name: ilyra-descendant-sets
local_skills.guidance: List each obligation's strict downstream dependants.

local_skills.guidance: Identify obligations with no declared predecessor.

local_skills.name: ilyra-maximal-obligations
local_skills.guidance: Identify obligations with no declared successor.

local_skills.name: ilyra-antichain-frontiers
local_skills.guidance: Partition obligations into deterministic antichain frontiers.

local_skills.name: ilyra-path-witness
local_skills.guidance: Return a shortest deterministic dependency path or explicit absence.

local_skills.guidance: Remove only transitively redundant edges while preserving reachability.

local_skills.guidance: Return one deterministic longest dependency path as a bounded witness.

local_skills.guidance: Enumerate inclusion-minimal internal cutsets for reachable root-to-leaf pairs.

local_skills.name: ilyra-evidence-frontier
local_skills.guidance: Separate currently satisfiable obligations from the explicit missing frontier.

local_skills.name: ilyra-authority-vacancy
local_skills.guidance: Represent absent authority without treating vacancy as denial or consent.

local_skills.name: ilyra-accessible-projection
local_skills.guidance: Render a deterministic text projection without claiming manual accessibility review.

local_skills.name: ilyra-external-evidence-gap
local_skills.guidance: Retain missing external evidence as an open gap rather than false data.

local_skills.name: ilyra-release-gate
local_skills.guidance: Keep publication and operational release closed without exact authority and evidence.
